pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, gentle morning atmosphere)

Soft light
through the window frame
morning slowly
finds the room

[Verse 1]
Seven in the morning
sunlight on the wall
a quiet warmth
touches my eyes

My shoulders feel lighter
than yesterday’s weight
and somewhere inside
a small melody begins

[Chorus]
Tomorrow feels close
like wind through the street
moving softly
around my steps

Small possibilities
glimmer in the air
and in this moment
I feel awake

[Verse 2]
People pass slowly
with morning smiles
and somehow I find
myself smiling too

A small café
a cup of warm coffee
holding quietly
the warmth of today

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, bright and hopeful)

[Bridge]
Sunlight between clouds
grows a little stronger
step by step

And somewhere inside
a quiet voice says
you can trust
your own light

[Chorus]
Tomorrow feels near
like an open sky
waiting gently
above the day

Every heartbeat
moves a little freer
and for a moment
I simply shine

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, warm fading notes)

Morning continues
beyond the window
and the road ahead
begins again
